compareDisposition.rationale: The curator examined The beloved inheritance is abandoned and may be restored beside Children rebel and only a remnant remains; The beloved vineyard yields wild grapes; Commission ends with cities empty and a stump; The earth is emptied under broken covenant. Those passages share its Eden-and-exile evidence group or canonical movement, but none supplies a distinct two-source relationship stronger than the accepted comparisons already carrying this topic.
